About

A bit about how I got here.

I'm a Computer Science graduate (BSCS, COMSATS University Islamabad, Abbottabad Campus) and a Junior MERN Stack Developer currently working at Codedile Solutions in Sargodha, Pakistan. My day-to-day work is building and maintaining responsive React.js interfaces, consuming REST APIs, and implementing JWT-based authentication — the practical, production side of full-stack development rather than just tutorials.

My core stack is React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB, with Tailwind CSS for UI and Redux Toolkit or Zustand for state management depending on the project. Outside of client work, I've shipped four documented personal projects covering a blogging platform, an e-commerce frontend, a Vue 3 patient portal, and a Unity-based virtual museum — each one picked to stretch a different part of the stack rather than repeat the same tutorial pattern.

I'm currently focused on deepening backend architecture and API design while continuing to write clean, maintainable, production-ready code on the frontend.
